description: Thirty years of work in the informal sector produces no pension record, no employment history a lender recognises, and no entitlement at the end.
money_note: Value of unaccrued entitlements over a working life.
energy_note: Thirty years of work, and no record that it happened.

description: Without formal employment there is no maternity entitlement, so the weeks before and after a birth are weeks with no income, in the health context of MAT-001.
energy_note: Giving birth, and simply not earning for two months.

aspect: Illness stops the income the same day
description: No sick pay means the trading day missed is the income missed, which is why people work through conditions that then become the chronic ones in SOM-001.
energy_note: Working ill, because the stall does not pay itself.

aspect: And credit costs more without a record
description: No payslip means informal lending at punitive rates, which is where the ransom and medical borrowing in SEC-001 and HLT-001 actually comes from.
energy_note: Borrowing at the worst rate, for the worst reasons.

aspect: SCENARIO - the day she could not open
description: Malaria on the Tuesday. The stall does not open Tuesday or Wednesday. That is NGN 18,000 of margin and the rent is on Friday, so she opens on Thursday still unwell and is worse for a fortnight.
energy_note: Two days closed, and a fortnight of being worse for it.
